lane:
مُرْتَجٌ A door, and a chamber, or house, _locked,_ or _shut_ or _closed,_ (مُغْلَقٌ,) _so as to be made fast,_ or _firm._ (A.)

مُرْتِجٌ , applied to a she-camel, ‡ _Pregnant;_ because the mouth of her womb becomes closed against the seed of the stallion: (T, A, * TA:) applied also to a she-ass, in the same sense: (TA:) pl. مَرَاتِجُ and مَرَاتِيجُ. (A, TA.)

entries.text: المرتج: المردارسنج، وليس بتصحيف: مريخ، والوجه ضم ميمه، لأنه معرب: مرده.
